tftp_root.description: Absolute path to the TFTP root directory. All files served must be under this directory.

tftp_user.description: System user account under which the TFTP service runs (for security isolation).

tftp_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) the TFTP server binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all IPv4 interfaces.

tftp_port.description: UDP port number for the TFTP service (standard TFTP port is 69).

tftp_options.description: Space-separated command-line options passed to the TFTP daemon. Common: --secure (disables write operations), --verbose (log extra info). Note: This variable maps to TFTP_OPTIONS in the init script.

tftp_ipv6_enabled.description: If true, enable IPv6 support. If false, IPv6 is disabled. Note: In tftpd-hpa, IPv6 is typically enabled by using --listen-ipv6 or specifying an IPv6 address.

tftp_umask.description: Umask (e.g., '022') to apply to newly created files in the TFTP directory. Omit (leave null) to use system default. Note: tftpd-hpa does not support umask natively in the init script defaults; this is included for schema compatibility but may require alternative configuration methods.

tftp_debug.description: If true, enables verbose debug logging (sent to syslog). Use only for troubleshooting. Note: In tftpd-hpa, this is often controlled via --verbose.
